articles.title: Meloni, Italia più solida e credibile, anche l'occupazione lo testimonia
articles.summary: Premier Meloni states Italy has become more economically solid and credible, citing employment growth and record-high occupation rates.

articles.title: Meloni: "Un presidente della Repubblica di destra potrebbe non essere più un tabù"
articles.summary: Premier Meloni suggests that a right-wing President of the Republic may no longer be a political taboo if her coalition wins re-election.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Premier Meloni confirms availability to testify as a witness-party in a defamation trial against Fabrizio Corona scheduled for September 28.
